I've got a sense for what you're looking for. Be back in less than a minute
i'm scanning through 50,000 jobs to find the perfect fit for you. you'll hear from me soon.

Python AI - Associate Data Scientist at Birlasoft

birlasoft has a python ai role in bangalore. pay is probably service company standard, so maybe 4-6 lpa. you're not building the next chatgpt, you're just the guy who cleans the data for their big clients. it's a classic it services gig, a good first step to get some experience on your resume then bounce.
Fresher jobs

i'm scanning thousands of roles an hour for you.

i'll ping you the second a good fresher role hits. don't settle for the garbage in between.

AI Engineer - Senior at EY

ey is hiring a senior ai engineer in bangalore.

ignore the 'senior' title, they'll lowball a fresher, guess around 8-10 lpa.

you won't be building the next chatgpt, you'll be making powerpoint decks about 'ai transformation' for clients who are still stuck on excel.

they probably need cheap python skills for proof-of-concepts, might be a boring but safe way to get the ey brand on your cv.

Experienced Software Engineer Java / Python (Full Stack or Back End) at hackajob

hackajob is looking for a java/python dev in bangalore.

they say 'experienced' but it's a recruiting platform, so they're just keyword stuffing; probably a 6-8 lpa gig for a sharp fresher.

you'll be building the backend tech that other engineers use to find jobs, so it's pretty meta.

apply anyway, the worst they can do is ghost you, and you need the interview practice.
